Amit, saw Casepoint advanced its platform unification and announced the Proofpoint partnership this spring.

A new platform story and partner channel usually open more in-market accounts than the team can cover before signals go stale, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Casepoint off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Amit, quick follow-up for Casepoint.

With a unified platform and new partner motion, pipeline expectations tend to outpace what headcount can cover, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the number. The gap shows up late, then it's a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Casepoint needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Amit, last bit of proof for Casepoint.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Casepoint's reply rate likely compares to other legal-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
